A prototype '''starship''' was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]'s [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Bellassa)|captain]] to shoot down two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing]]s piloted by members of [[the Eleven]] resistance group. The [[Spy/Legends|double-agent]] [[Ferus Olin]] and another [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Bellassa)|officer]] also served aboard the vessel.<ref name="Secret weapon" />
